chunks: When he saw their hands not reaching (the food), he became suspicious of them and felt fear from them. They said: 'Do not be afraid. We have been sent to the people of Lot.'

key_terms.أَوْجَسَ: he felt a sudden fear / unease
key_terms.نَكَرَهُمْ: he became suspicious of them / did not recognize them

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet feel fear when the angels did not eat his food?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) perceives the angels' unusual behavior of not eating, which triggers his innate fear (khauf) of potential harm, a reaction consistent with his status as a prophet sensitive to divine signs. The angels reassure him by announcing their specific mission to destroy the people of Lot, clarifying that their purpose is not merely hospitality but divine judgment. This moment highlights the transition from Ibrahim's hospitality to the execution of God's decree against Sodom and Gomorrah.
